systems.system: FCC property tax and business licence database
systems.platform: points-based valuation from satellite images; Plus Codes for building identification
systems.tiers: Freetown City Council only; more than 160,000 properties against 60,000 in the old database, 2020 tax year

note: Freetown City Council's FAQ on its property tax and business licensing reform (begun September 2019) describes a revenue application; it states nothing on how the council's office is connected.
